caption: After the first update the centroids are C1=[2.5,0.5] and C2=[0.5,2.5], each the mean of its two documents. Every document is about 0.71 (Euclidean) from its own centroid and farther from the other one, so no document switches cluster and k-means stops.

spec.aria: A two-dimensional graph plots four document vectors D1=[3,0], D2=[2,1], D3=[0,3], D4=[1,2] with the updated centroid C1=[2.5,0.5] between D1 and D2 and C2=[0.5,2.5] between D3 and D4, each document about 0.71 from its own centroid.
